text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waaah~~♪ Messiah-san, look at this!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...'Taking on the Umamusume bread 
challenge'?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, they say you can customize it based 
on your favorite Umamusume! How nice! So 
cute! Decorating it sounds like so much 
fun!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If you're interested, would you like to 
give it a try? The recipe is included as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but baking bread is tough, right? My 
cooking skills are pretty average... I-I 
wonder if I can really do it...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As long as we have a recipe, we'll be 
fine. I can help out too if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Are you sure? Then please, do!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get started, then? First, let's 
measure out the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Weighing 150g of bread flour on the 
scale...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I put in a little too much. Well, it's 
only a tiny bit, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's reduce it, shall we? It's merely 3g, 
but 3g nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Next is a 10-minute intermediate proofing 
period. Let's take a short break as well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Then let's watch TV! There's a rerun 
of a school drama that's super 
interesting~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It's been 10 minutes. Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the drama is just getting to the good 
part!? Just a little bit longer—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's head back! Hang on, my bread 
dough~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, there are still this many steps 
left...? The fun part of decorating is 
still so far away~...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We are steadily getting closer to 
completion. Let's take it steadily and 
reliably, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ Time for the long-awaited 
decorating!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
How should I make them~♪ Put on some ears~ 
use chocolate dough to create different 
colors~...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... that's true. Shall we try various 
things?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: All finished~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You're very skilled. It's crafted with 
such great detail and originality.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
By comparison, I'm... so ordinary... Like, 
by-the-book, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's not ordinary at all! You're so 
good it's like a textbook example. I think 
it's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I always just wing things however I 
like... so I really admire people who can 
follow recipes and do things by the book~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Plus, my bread and Messiah's bread are 
totally different, so that's fine too! 
Let's compare the tastes and see if 
they're different!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You're just like the sun, 
Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaan! Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's homemade bread♪ I made it together 
with Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was handed a piece of bread shaped like 
Rhein Kraft's face. The craftsmanship is 
truly impressive.
choice_data_list: You must've been through a lot, huh?
Whoa~ You're really good at this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was handed a piece of bread shaped like 
Rhein Kraft's face. The craftsmanship is 
truly impressive.
choice_data_list: You must've been through a lot, huh?
Whoa~ You're really good at this!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right... But Messiah-san made it together 
with me, so it was all okay♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That was a lot of fun, wasn't it? ...I 
even feel energized from it all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cheer up...? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just took it of my own accord. 
Like basking in the sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right. I heard that Messiah-san can make 
almost any bread or pastry as long as she 
has the recipe!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, Messiah-san. Will you cook with me 
again?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd be glad to help if you'll have 
me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! To be honest, there are so many 
things I wanted to make, but didn't think 
I could do on my own.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Messiah-san is around, I feel 
like I can do anything♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, saying 'anything' is a bit much. 
...Still, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's too difficult for one person, 
two can do it. ...With you, Craft-san, I 
know we can.
